title: Three-subject mock recall status and release criteria
answerToQuestion: NO — full AQA bullet-by-bullet coverage and individual correctness of every mock flashcard cannot yet be certified.

schoolMockBoundaries.physics: AQA Year 1/AS Physics sections 3.1–3.5; questions may require A-level depth of application but not untaught A2 content.
schoolMockBoundaries.chemistry: AS Chemistry plus school-taught Year 2 content through Kp, Gibbs/Born–Haber, rate laws, acids including Kw and taught organic through carbonyl/carboxylic acid/ester/acyl chemistry; buffer questions excluded.
schoolMockBoundaries.maths: FIRST mock only: Year 1 Pure Maths sections A–J (omitting I), no Statistics, Mechanics, or deferred Year 2 radian and calculus content.

completionCriteria: Freeze exact November school mock scope from teacher. Separate first Maths Pure mock from later Year 2 paper.
For each assessable AQA left-column statement and required practical interpretation, attach a verified mock-eligible card ID or justify why it is primarily an application question.
Read every mapped question and model answer for scientific/Mathematical precision, ambiguities and accepted variants.
Run original and negative regression answers with current website grader and manually review disputed marks.
Check published site loads the final content, not just the GitHub main branch; verify cloud progress, offline caching and topics.
Audit source-indexed 2015–2026 exam questions separately from independently authored practice.
limitations: No claim that every single AQA assessable point has now been reviewed. Existing historical audits review sampled/selected subsets, not a full independent examiner check of every card.
